content_fields.title: Implement RBAC instead of individual accounts
content_fields.description: Grant access through roles rather than through individually managed accounts.
content_fields.guidance: Permissions should attach to a small set of roles that reflect job functions, with users receiving access solely by role membership, so entitlements can be reviewed and revoked as a set.
content_fields.found: The application itself already models three roles; the gap is at the infrastructure layer, where database and host access use shared individual accounts such as the `admin` PostgreSQL user.
content_fields.missing: Role definitions in the database and host platforms, and a directory to attach them to.
content_fields.conclusion: Infrastructure-level role-based access control is configured in the database server and host platform, not in this repository's source.
content_fields.action: The platform and database administration teams should define infrastructure roles and retire shared individual accounts.
